cohort: All children born in Denmark between January 2005 and December 2018 with available information on duration of exclusive breastfeeding were included.
finding: Exclusive breastfeeding for 3 months or longer was associated with a decreased risk of hematologic cancers, largely attributable to decreased risk of B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia (BCP-ALL), compared with exclusive breastfeeding duration of less than 3 months.
